## Summary

Describe what changed.

## Motivation and references

Explain why. Link a related Issue or approved design decision when applicable.

## Testing evidence

List checks performed and their results. Explain anything not tested.

## Risks and limitations

Describe relevant risks, remaining limitations, or follow-up work.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change stays within scope and follows approved architecture, or flags decisions needing review.
- [ ] Relevant checks were run and results recorded above.
- [ ] Documentation is accurate about planned versus implemented functionality.
- [ ] No private datasets, credentials, secrets, or runtime data are included; examples are synthetic.
- [ ] CSV/TSV fixture bytes are preserved and intentional byte changes are explained, if applicable.
